Bru — Bidirectional Remote Uplink

  • Read and send SMS from your web browser.
  • Get notified on your desktop when an SMS arrives.
  • Copy text to and from your phone's clipboard.

Bru (bridge in Norwegian) syncs your Android SMS to any browser, so you can text from the computer you're already working on instead of reaching for your phone. It does this by creating an end-to-end encrypted connection to a companion app running as a background service on your phone.

Features

  • Encrypted. Your data is only readable by you.
  • Fully local. No personal data is stored outside of your devices.
  • Hole punching. Works from behind routers and firewalls. No port forwarding or fiddling with NAT.

Get started

The companion app is available in the IzzyOnDroid app repo, as a downloadable .apk-file from github, or you can build the APK yourself. Once it's installed, pair the phone by scanning the QR-code below.

Advanced options

Custom Iroh relay

Bru uses n0's Iroh relays by default, but if you want to you can use others, even your own!

The companion Android app will have to be configured the same way.
